archetypes.name: telemetry
archetypes.rationale: Diff adds a new timing-ledger round row schema and JSON aggregation path that can silently break downstream timing consumers.
archetypes.prompt_body: Investigate the end-to-end telemetry contract across timing-ledger writes, timing-report aggregation, and published run-log artifacts. Check whether the new round rows remain additive, schema-compatible, correctly scoped by skill and step interval, and safe for existing consumers that parse timing reports. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.

archetypes.name: bash32
archetypes.rationale: Most changes are portable shell/awk code that must keep working under macOS Bash 3.2 and strict shell modes.
archetypes.prompt_body: Review the changed shell scripts for Bash 3.2 compatibility, quoting, local variable behavior, subshell side effects, trap interactions, and awk or grep portability. Pay special attention to new helper scripts, ledger parsing, and loops that rely on strict mode or best-effort failure swallowing. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.

archetypes.name: handoff
archetypes.rationale: Deferred MAV and coder-main-agent timing paths span prompt-side skill markdown, helper scripts, and resume wrappers.
archetypes.prompt_body: Trace the main-agent-vote-required and coder-main-agent-required handoff flows for both implement and design. Verify round-start persistence, post-adjudication re-tallying, deferred row emission, stall handling, and resume behavior are ordered so counts and durations are neither lost nor double-recorded. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.

archetypes.name: jsonawk
archetypes.rationale: The timing-report JSON construction is hand-built in awk and sensitive to commas, intervals, sorting, and child-step boundaries.
archetypes.prompt_body: Examine the timing-report JSON emission logic, especially how per-round arrays are attached, ordered, and comma-delimited. Verify nested child step intervals use the child bounds, absent or mismatched rows do not create misleading arrays, and generated JSON remains valid for edge cases such as zero counts and clamped durations. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.

archetypes.name: publish
archetypes.rationale: Design publish changes alter freshness and cleanup behavior for timing-report artifacts copied into run logs.
archetypes.prompt_body: Review the design publish and run-log publication path for stale artifact risks and unintended deletion or publication of timing sidecars. Check whether render failures leave the publish surface clean, warnings are recorded appropriately, and successful renders publish only the validated final JSON without disrupting final summaries. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
